data.why: the repository ships its own example light curves and periods pickle (example/light_curves, example/periods.pkl) used directly by the start command; the browser interacts with the running Bokeh app rather than uploading files

goals: visually inspect folded phase light curves of periodic variable stars to judge data quality
classify each light curve into a variable-star class (RR Lyrae, Eclipsing Binary, Cepheid, Other)
page through batches of 9 light curves at a time to review a full survey subset
resume labeling work from a saved backup after leaving and returning
find the first unlabeled light curve to continue a labeling session efficiently

review.summary: The tree describes the interface well: the phases are right, the coverage is good, the features are well cut, and every screen I opened except the colour claim shows what its node says. It needs fixing before it is filed: it trusts the app's backwards legend, so the colour-to-period mapping that classification depends on is wrong; it says the backup happens 'when the page advances' when it only happens after the ninth label; and it reports a missing page 2 that does not exist.
